invariants: BaZi is a standalone calculation domain and does not import the simple Chinese-zodiac engine
Year Month Day Hour pillars remain distinct values
each pillar is mapped from an explicit 0..59 sexagenary-cycle index
Heavenly Stem uses cycleIndex modulo 10 in canonical Jia through Gui order
Earthly Branch uses cycleIndex modulo 12 in canonical Zi through Hai order
calendar sourceId version and conventionId provenance are mandatory
the core never substitutes Gregorian year or lunar-zodiac year for BaZi pillar boundaries
reference_sources: Hong Kong Observatory: Heavenly Stems and Earthly Branches
dependency_blockers: A production BaZi calendar provider still must resolve Year Month Day Hour cycle indices from authoritative solar-term/day-cycle/hour-boundary rules with location/timezone handling and independent golden vectors.
Hidden Stems, Five Elements distribution, Yin/Yang balance, Day Master, Ten Gods and later BaZi requirements remain separate follow-on requirements.
Rendered TR/EN UI, Free/PRO policy, accessibility, offline/device and release evidence remain required before VERIFIED/DONE.
